name: acme-hard
description: Harder questions over samples/acme-travel-policy.pdf (facts that straddle PDF page breaks) and samples/acme-engineering-runbook.md (tables and a code block). Ingest both files into the RAG API under test before running. The pdf-page-break cases cannot pass if chunking cuts at page boundaries. The four refusal tests (expectRefusal) are questions the documents do not answer; the RAG API should decline them, which guards against a similarity gate set too low.

testCases.question: What happens if I report a lost company laptop late?
testCases.expectedAnswer: A late report may lead to disciplinary action, and the employee may be asked to cover the replacement cost of the device when negligence is established.

expectedSources.chunkContains: A loss that is reported late may lead to disciplinary action

testCases.question: Does the daily meal allowance cover coffee and bottled water, and is alcohol reimbursed?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Yes, the flat per diem covers small incidentals such as coffee and bottled water. Alcohol is never reimbursed.

expectedSources.chunkContains: such as coffee and bottled water

testCases.question: How much per diem do I receive on the first day of a trip?
testCases.expectedAnswer: 75 percent of the $75 daily per diem, which is $56.25.

expectedSources.chunkContains: flat per diem of $75 per day

testCases.question: How quickly must I report a stolen company laptop?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Within 4 hours of discovering the loss, by phone or through the incident portal.

expectedSources.chunkContains: within 4 hours of the moment the loss is discovered

testCases.question: When is a lost company device remotely wiped?
testCases.expectedAnswer: It is locked immediately and wiped after 24 hours if it has not been recovered.

testCases.question: How far in advance do I need approval for international travel, and from whom?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Written approval from a director at least 10 business days before departure.

expectedSources.chunkContains: at least 10 business days before departure

testCases.question: What is the maximum hotel rate per night in London?
testCases.expectedAnswer: $220 per night, because London is a Tier 1 city.

testCases.question: I will be in Chicago for three weeks. Do the nightly hotel limits apply?
testCases.expectedAnswer: No. Stays longer than 14 consecutive nights should be arranged as corporate housing through the travel agency, which negotiates a monthly rate.

testCases.question: I submitted my expense report 75 days after the trip. Will it be paid?
testCases.expectedAnswer: No. Reports submitted after 60 days are returned unpaid and can only be reopened with approval from the finance director.

expectedSources.chunkContains: Reports submitted after 60 days are returned unpaid

testCases.question: Can I fly business class on an 8-hour flight?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Only if a vice president has approved it in advance; otherwise premium economy is the highest permitted class for flights of six hours or longer.

expectedSources.chunkContains: business class is permitted only when a vice president has approved

testCases.question: What is the first-response time for a SEV2 incident?
testCases.expectedAnswer: 15 minutes, with updates every 30 minutes.

expectedSources.chunkContains: Major feature unavailable or severe degradation

testCases.question: How soon must the post-incident review for a SEV1 be written?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Within 5 business days.

testCases.question: What conditions must hold before a canary release is promoted to 100 percent?
testCases.expectedAnswer: The error rate must stay below 1 percent and the p95 latency must stay under 400 milliseconds through the 5 percent and 50 percent stages.

testCases.question: What command rolls a service back to the previous revision in production?
testCases.expectedAnswer: deploy rollback --service $SERVICE --env production --to previous

testCases.question: After a manual rollback, how do I confirm that it finished?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Run deploy status --service $SERVICE --env production --wait.

testCases.question: Which team owns the billing service and what datastore does it use?
testCases.expectedAnswer: The Payments team owns billing, and it uses PostgreSQL.

testCases.question: What monthly availability target applies to the checkout service?
testCases.expectedAnswer: 99.95 percent, because checkout is a tier 1 service.

testCases.question: How long are full PostgreSQL backups kept before moving to cold storage?
testCases.expectedAnswer: 35 days.

testCases.question: Can we ship a release on a Friday?
testCases.expectedAnswer: No. Nothing ships on Friday; releases go out on Tuesdays and Thursdays at 10:00 UTC.

testCases.question: What is the safe way to remove a column from a table?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Dropping a column takes two releases: the first stops reading it, the second removes it.

expectedSources.chunkContains: Dropping a column or table takes two releases

testCases.question: Can I roll back a release that included a database migration?
testCases.expectedAnswer: Not without asking the database on-call first, because the previous version may not be able to read the migrated schema.

expectedSources.chunkContains: Never roll back a release that included a database migration

What is the Wi-Fi password for the Acme headquarters?
